finding.text: At 400 px the Recite control line squeezes its label and progress line to about 40 px, so the label reads only "not…" (Sizing, Wrapping) — shots/127-0-0-1-60498-framework-audio-Recite/400.png, the demo's bottom band. This is the phone, the width the owner will use on the walk. In the phone sheet the mic sits beside the bar, so the space is smaller still. Fix: hide the threshold slider and voice picker behind the ear button on narrow screens, or let the track take a second row.

No shot shows the bar in the phone chat sheet (✦), and that is the owner's first ask ("a reply is read aloud in one chat view on the phone"). review.mjs shot only the three audio pages. The task log claims headless proofs, but none is filed in the task folder. Add one 400 px shot of the sheet with the bar above the mic.

The hand-off is missing. Requirements step 3 asks for the merge command and what to try on the walk, and Done #1 is "the owner can test it on the walk". Neither is in the task folder yet (no handoff file, and the last task.jsonl line is the shots line).

plan.md §6 still says "Filled in from the class map (below) once it is read", and the section is empty. The answer exists (task.jsonl decision "the live wire"; dictation-notes.md), but a fresh agent who reads plan.md meets a stale placeholder. Fill §6 with that one line and a link, or replace it with one.
Servex/readme.md, the `ext/` row (line 47), lists `remote/ openrouter/ refine/ local/` but not the new `recite/`. Law 10: index what you create.

Server/readme.md names `plugins/Whisper.js` but not the new `plugins/Recite.js` or its `/recite/*` routes. Server/doc/mobile-lan.md lists `/whisper/*` as a LAN-allowed route, but not `/recite/*`, which has the same guard.

The voice agent coordination ask is not addressed. `Servex/ext/remote/doc/cloud-voice-agent.md` is untouched, and nothing says whether the Claude-app voice agent should hand off to Recite or ignore it. `/recite/*` uses the same `lan()` + `safe_host()` guard as `/whisper/*`, so it should work through the tunnel exactly where Whisper does. That is not proven.

audio/Voice/doc/owner-2026-10-16-voice-conversation.md line 3 still calls Voice "browser `speechSynthesis` only". Voice.js and its readme dropped the `d-voice-engine` reference, and `audio/doc/decisions.md` has no voice entry at all, so the link in that note now points at nothing.

At 1200 px, adding the Voice and Recite tabs pushes the audio tab strip past its width. The Voice page scrolls it so it begins "…ER TRANSCRIBER" (layout.json tabs_gap -276), and the overview cuts "DOCS" at the right edge (shots/127-0-0-1-60498-framework-audio/1200.png, top band). It is still one row (tab_rows 1).

`audio/Recite/BargeIn.js` imports `ux/Dictate/Dictate.js` only to read `whisper_url`. That makes the audio building block depend on a ux surface. Passing the URL in, or reading it from `audio/Whisper`, keeps audio below ux.
layout.json for /framework/audio/ records a 404 at both widths. It may predate this diff, but it was not traced.
